title: Variable-Length Audio Fingerprinting
abstract: arXiv:2603.23947v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Audio fingerprinting converts audio to much lower-dimensional representations, allowing distorted recordings to still be recognized as their originals through similar fingerprints. Existing deep learning approaches rigidly fingerprint fixed-length audio segments, thereby neglecting temporal dynamics during segmentation. To address limitations due to this rigidity, we propose Variable-Length Audio FingerPrinting (VLAFP), a novel method that supports variable-length fingerprinting. To the best of our knowledge, VLAFP is the first deep audio fingerprinting model capable of processing audio of variable length, for both training and testing. Our experiments show that VLAFP outperforms existing state-of-the-arts in live audio identification and audio retrieval across three real-world datasets.

translated_abstract: 音频指纹技术将音频转换为维度更低的表示，使得失真的录音仍然可以通过相似的指纹被识别为其原始版本。现有的深度学习方法只能对固定长度的音频片段进行指纹提取，从而忽略了分段过程中的时间动态特性。为了解决这种僵化带来的局限性，我们提出了可变长度音频指纹，这是一种支持可变长度指纹提取的新方法。据我们所知，VLAFP是首个能够处理可变长度音频的深度音频指纹模型，无论在训练还是测试阶段均适用。我们的实验表明，VLAFP在三个真实世界数据集上的实时音频识别和音频检索任务中均优于现有最先进的方法。
tldr: 提出了首个在训练和测试阶段均能处理可变长度音频的深度音频指纹模型VLAFP，在实时音频识别和音频检索任务上超越了现有最先进方法。
